method: transpose(skyfield.sgp4lib.TEME.rotation_at(t)); elementwise linear interpolation followed by Gram-Schmidt row orthonormalization
limitations: A geometric frame orientation, not measured satellite telemetry or an orbit solution.
GCRS axes align with ICRF; this asset does not perform Earth translation or relativistic GCRS/BCRS origin transformations.
Uses Skyfield 1.53 packaged leap-second/delta-T predictions; regenerate if those time models change or after 2036.
Transform states and Earth heliocentric position at the same UTC instant. Never extrapolate outside the table.
This rotation does not include apparent light-time, aberration, refraction or Earth-surface polar-motion corrections.
